wants.topic: Economic realities and sociopolitical coercion behind soldier enlistment in modern authoritarian regimes
wants.evidence: The Present Past video 'Why Russians Still Sign Up to Die' performed 31.23x above channel normal with comments heavily discussing local village wages vs. military pay ($2500/mo) and police coercion tactics.

wants.topic: Covert state intelligence scandals, black ops, and military cover-ups involving civilian infrastructure
wants.evidence: The Present Past video 'The Israeli Plane Crash Conspiracy' performed 10.65x above normal, with top comments highlighting missing black boxes, Mossad secrecy, and covert arms transport on civilian flights.

wants.topic: Systemic failures of international peacekeeping bodies (UN) during modern ethnic conflicts
wants.evidence: The Present Past video 'When a Genocide Was Broadcast Live on TV' generated 8.7k comments focusing on UN incompetence, peacekeeper helplessness, and international inaction in Srebrenica and Rwanda.

wants.topic: Tactical combat mechanics, command insubordination, and stimulant/drug use in WWII blitzkriegs
wants.evidence: World at War video '1940: The Fall of France (UNCENSORED)' performed 5.72x above normal, with viewers discussing Guderian disobeying Hitler and the use of Pervitin.

gaps: Deep-dive investigations into international intelligence cover-ups involving civilian air transit and declassified arms transfers.
Granular economic analyses of draft incentives vs local poverty in non-Western militaries.
Unfiltered historical breakdowns of UN peacekeeper rules of engagement failures during 1990s genocides.
saturated: Standard political figure biographies lacking a sharp geopolitical crisis angle (e.g., generic Cheney/politician overviews).
Broad, high-level summaries of well-known wars like Vietnam without a distinct local perspective or new archival focus.
